title: Applications
line: We design what carries your brand: cards, letterheads, signs, social posts and slides.
intro: Your brand meets people on a card, a letterhead, a sign, a post and a slide. We design the ones you will reach for first, once, and ready to print or post. Each piece takes one risk (a scale, a crop, a material or a line) and is disciplined everywhere else.

example.title: The card
example.body: A 9 mm square is cut through the paper face, the size of the stop. Stacked, the edges show a raspberry line.
example.gaveUp: We gave up printing the stop. It is cut through the card, and the raspberry core shows.
example.label: Our own brand. 3D render. Printer samples to come.
